_comment: Anchor 1, per-instance mismatch. Same axes, seed and run-step changes as request-nominal-process.json (read that
file's _comment first); only the sections and the vary axis differ, so the two requests are two instruments on the
same draw grid, and their variances are NOT added (PDK gap G3: no joint process+mismatch section exists).
Sections are the PDK's own mismatch bundles: *_mismatch in cornerHBT/MOShv/CAP.lib pull the *_mod_mismatch libraries,
whose per-instance agauss() terms (npn13G2v qarea sigma 0.1; cap_cmim cap_carea_mm sigma 0.01; sg13_hv_svaricap w/l
sigma 3 nm per cell) are ACTIVE here (mm_ok=1 is each mismatch subckt's own default). Global process is held at the
typical sections (plain *_mod libraries, no gauss() params), so under vary="mismatch" the process_seed component is
the constant "fixed" and only the mismatch component (via the combined rndseed ngspice receives) moves per sample.
The 32 svaricap cells are 32 independent w/l draws per sample.
engine_version 47 is a fail-closed pin (issue #3041): the fleet runner image carries ngspice-47 since
~2026-11-13; ngspice-46 aborts nothing here but 47 WITHOUT the selft=0 overlay NaNs at the first
timepoint (see vco_core_body_selft0.spice header and the run record). If the image's solver changes
again, every unit fails the pin instead of producing numbers nobody can reproduce.

measurements.name: t_cross_11
